body.name: Deleted-diagonal failure flow
body.construction: Build a network with source arcs of capacity \(h_j\) to left nodes \(j\in\mathcal J\), middle arcs of capacity \(2\) from \(j\) to right nodes \(i\in\{0\}\cup\mathcal J\) only when \(i\neq j\), right capacities \(p_0\) at node \(0\) and \(b_i\) at node \(i\in\mathcal J\), and use \(\operatorname{TAKE}\) to realize a maximum flow as disjoint failure pieces before filling every residual row demand inside the already covered failure union.
